title: Warhammer 40K: Dark Heresy launches January 28 ⚔️
subject: darkheresy
description:
Are you playing as a psyker or a Kroot fan? 👇

Owlcat Games announced on November 9, 2026 that Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy, the follow-up to Rogue Trader, launches January 28, 2027 on PC (Steam, GOG, Epic), PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The founders' beta closes January 7 ahead of launch.

Sources: Owlcat Games on Steam News (Nov 9, 2026), RPG Site (Nov 9, 2026), PC Gamer (Nov 9, 2026)
Game footage © Owlcat Games / Games Workshop.

scenes.text: Owlcat's next Warhammer RPG finally has a date.
Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy launches January 28, 2027, on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X and S.
It follows Rogue Trader. This time you start as a lowly acolyte of the Inquisition in the Calixis Sector.
Your war band of zealots and outcasts hunts down cults, from the slums to the noble spires.
Companions include Ra'akhti, a Kroot, and Laarthyr, an Aeldari Corsair.

scenes.text: The founders' beta closes on January 7, three weeks before launch.
